scoring_justification: Recomputing the full band structure is impractical for the checker; compare extracted energies at high-symmetry points to paper-reported reference energies with tolerance.

hidden_assets.purpose: reference band energies at Gamma, X, K, L points extracted from Fig. 3 of the paper
hidden_assets.source_provenance: paper Fig. 3 band structure plot for CrN
hidden_assets.generation_method: visual estimation from the band structure plot; approximate values for the lowest 5 bands at each symmetry point
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: values are taken from the paper's published plot and serve as the expected gold reference for the checker

outputs.description: Band energies E(k) computed from the finite-difference Bloch-lattice model. The hidden checker will extract energies at the high-symmetry points Γ, X, K, L and compare them to paper reference values within an appropriate tolerance; it will also verify metallic character (at least one band crossing the Fermi level along each direction).

output_contract.notes: The agent must implement the finite-difference scheme as described; any reasonable grid spacing that yields a converged band structure is acceptable. The hidden tolerance accounts for the expected spread from different discretisation choices and software environments.
